lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD roo $110 + lowest folder $25 = $135; 135 / 1.22 = 110.66, round down to $110. Flip: likely resale from SOLD evidence about $110 (roo) + $35 (folder) = $145; less about 13% selling fees ($18.85) and $12 tracked outbound postage = $114.15; / 2.44 = 46.8, round down to $45.
